properties.description: tools/test_run_ci_gates.py, five hermetic tests, run in CI. Nothing here runs cargo, spawns a server or touches the design. It exists because the runner's own failure mode is the one the runner exists to end, and a runner that reports green having run nothing would be the joke telling itself.
properties.findings: First run 2026-09-20: four passed and ONE FAILED, and the failing one was the test rather than the runner. It asserted that running from a directory with no ci.yml must be refused; the runner resolves the workflow from its own file location, so it is correctly immune to the working directory and that cannot be used to fake a broken read. The test was rewritten to drive the guard directly with a patched parser, which is what it should have done in the first place. All five pass. The runner itself was corrected before this net existed: its first draft printed a clean summary on a filter matching nothing and never returned a non-zero exit code at all.
properties.name: The gate runner fails on zero gates, on a broken workflow read, and in its exit code
